testName: Campaign Member Status Progression, ROI Calculation & Influenced Opps
steps:
1. Open Campaigns tab
2. Open Campaign "Q3 Enterprise Tech Summit"
3. In Campaign Members related list, locate Contact "Elena Rostova"
4. Update Member Status from "Sent" to "Attended Conference" (Responded=True)
5. Click on Save button
6. Open Opportunity "Acme Corporation - Cloud Transformation" linked to Elena's account
7. Move Opportunity stage to "Closed Won" with Amount $250,000
8. Return to Campaign record
9. Verify "Value Won Opportunities in Campaign" reflects $250,000
10. Verify Campaign ROI formula calculates positive return against Actual Cost budget
